about: Prototype 11: Story Map 1 as nine puzzles, redesigned (GDD Edit 115, after the Edit 114 pressure test). Set by hand. One learner: RED-01, a sedan, rung 0 to 7 over the nine (puzzle 4 teaches roof lidar and street cameras together); certified, it returns on Map 2 as a drone car. Rungs: 0 blind, 1 forward camera, 2 side sensors, 3 roof lidar, 4 street cameras, 5 road items, 6 crash memory, 7 search. Kit: the parts issued for this test (battery1 dash, hands1 cones, knees1 Super Knees duck). Fleet: story.traffic.monument.<tile>; 0 clears every white car off the tile and its neighbours, decks included. Route: the red car's lane (duel.route, proposed). Layout (Edit 115): drop [x, y]; cones [] or [[x, y]...]; cover [{kind, at 0..1 along the route on screen, side left|right|N|S|E|W, gap from the kerb}]. Par and target in seconds (story.puzzle.par.<tile>, story.puzzle.target.<tile>, proposed). The traffic-light switch and the clients move to Map 2 (Parkland), with its new learner.

map.title: MAP 1 · MONUMENT
map.intro: Dummy Corporation welcomes you off the factory floor. The cars are your colleagues; the red one learns. Certification is your goal.

boss.text: Three pieces: a tall one no camera sees, a low one, and a tall one a street camera watches. A dash breaks the camera's post.

puzzles.name: First Contact
puzzles.new: The red car. It is blind.

objective.label: GET HIT BY THE RED CAR

puzzles.tale: Fresh off the factory floor. Your first colleague is red, keen and blind. Walk out and meet it.
puzzles.twist: Walk into its side and the fault is yours: no points.
hints: It cannot see you. Be where it is going, and wait.
puzzles.solution: Stand in its lane; let it come.

puzzles.name: Stop Line
puzzles.new: Its forward camera. It stops for you in its lane.

objective.label: GET HIT BY THE RED CAR

puzzles.tale: RED-01 now has eyes on its bonnet. It brakes for anything in its lane. Anything it sees in time.
puzzles.twist: Stand in its lane: it stops at its line.
hints: It stops for what it sees in its lane. Step in when it can no longer stop.
puzzles.solution: Wait at the kerb; step in inside its stop line.

puzzles.name: High Road
puzzles.new: Its side sensors. It sees the kerb.

objective.label: GET HIT BY THE RED CAR

puzzles.tale: RED-01 now watches both kerbs. The high road above it has a gap in its parapet. Gravity is company policy.
puzzles.twist: Wait at the kerb: it sees you and stops short.
hints: It watches the kerbs, not the sky.
puzzles.solution: Escalator up to the high road; drop through the parapet gap as it passes under.

puzzles.name: The Island

objective.label: GET HIT BY THE RED CAR

puzzles.tale: The plaque reads ZERO ACCIDENTS. Its sensors cannot see through the kiosk on the island. You can dash.
puzzles.twist: Walk out: it sees you. Dash at its side: your fault.
hints: Hide where its sensors cannot see. Dash to land ahead of its nose.
puzzles.solution: Cross to the island; hide behind the kiosk; dash to land ahead of its nose.

puzzles.name: CCTV
puzzles.new: Street cameras. A dash breaks a post.

objective.label: GET HIT BY THE RED CAR

puzzles.tale: The neon shops sell nothing, but the traffic reads them. So do the street cameras, and they report.
puzzles.twist: Hide behind the cabinet: the camera tells the car.
hints: A dash breaks a camera post. Break it while the car is away.
puzzles.solution: Dash into the camera post between passes; then hide behind the cabinet and dash.

puzzles.name: Swerve

objective.label: GET HIT BY THE RED CAR

puzzles.tale: The stacked cubes rose one budget at a time. Today you test with Hands 1 alone. It swerves round cones.
puzzles.twist: No dash: it sees you at the kerb and stops short.
hints: A cone in its lane: it swerves. Be where the swerve goes.
puzzles.solution: Carry a cone into its lane; hide behind the kiosk; step into the other lane as it swerves.

puzzles.name: Portal
puzzles.new: Road items. It stops for cones.

objective.label: GET HIT BY THE RED CAR

puzzles.tale: The road runs through the portal tower at the sixth floor. RED-01 now stops for anything left in the road.
puzzles.twist: A cone in its lane: it stops now.
hints: Cones stop it. Cameras still break.
puzzles.solution: Break the camera between passes; hide behind the kiosk; dash.

puzzles.name: LED Canyon
puzzles.new: Super Knees: hold C to duck.

objective.label: GET HIT BY THE RED CAR

puzzles.tale: Two screens advertise to each other all night. Low hedges line the canyon. Your new knees fold.
puzzles.twist: Hide behind the hedge standing: it sees you over it.
hints: Low cover hides you only if you are lower. Hold C.
puzzles.solution: Duck behind the hedge (hold C); dash out as it passes.

puzzles.name: Certification
puzzles.new: A boss. It learns between your hits.

objective.label: THREE HITS · A NEW WAY EACH

puzzles.tale: Certification. RED-01 has learned from every dummy so far. It will learn from you three more times.
puzzles.twist: The same move twice: it remembers.
hints: A street camera tells it what it sees. Hide where the camera cannot look.
It remembers where you came from. Use a new spot.
A dash breaks a camera post. Then its cover is yours.
puzzles.solution: Hit 1 from the cabinet. Hit 2 ducked behind the hedge. Hit 3: break the camera, dash from the kiosk.

elements: clients on a crossing (the van swerves late)
RED-01 returns as a Senior drone car with its rungs
